title: Operate and Troubleshoot Search
readerIntent: Qualify, monitor, recover, and tune a configured search provider.
priorKnowledge: Know the selected engine, topology, tenant routing, mappings, and consistency policy.
owner: Configured search provider and deployment operators
summary: Production search requires live-provider security, health, capacity, recovery, mapping, and consistency qualification beyond deterministic framework tests.

sections.heading: Monitor
items: Index size, shard/replica capacity, and cache effects.
Safe tenant-aware error and throughput dimensions.

sections.heading: Secure
items: Use TLS, authenticated engine access, restricted credentials, and secret governance.
Keep management endpoints and provider diagnostics out of public routes.
Preserve tenant routing and authorization before query execution.
Do not log unrestricted query content, credentials, or raw provider errors.

sections.heading: Recover
items: Define reconnect and bounded retry behavior.
Reconcile the derived index from authoritative records.
Use versioned indexes and aliases for incompatible mapping migrations.
Qualify snapshot/restore according to the engine and deployment.
Test degraded startup, provider outage, reconnect, reindex, rollback, and cleanup.

sections.heading: Local versus production
paragraphs: A locally running Elasticsearch instance proves integration mechanics only. Production qualification must cover authentication, encryption, supported versions, capacity, high availability, backup, recovery, monitoring, and incident procedures.
